content.howToUse: How to use the Meeting Timer:
steps: At the beginning of each meeting, select how you want to be notified about upcoming stages.
Set the start and end time for your meeting.
Define the stages and their durations.
One minute before a stage change and during stage transitions, you'll receive notifications.
When you actually start the meeting, click "Start meeting".
When each stage is completed, click the "Next" button for that stage.
The assistant will track delays and show how stage start times shift if you're running late.
You can save meetings using the URL.
featureList: Visual stage tracking with current stage highlighting
Automatic time adjustment for late meetings
Notification options (browser notifications, sound only, or no notifications)
